disclosure_bar.rule: presence of at least 3 of 5 link classes

frame.population_description: the 46 candidates frozen in regulator-transparency.expanded-v1.json for axis regulator-transparency
frame.inclusion_rule: Every candidate in the frozen file was attempted exactly once at run time; no candidate was added, dropped, substituted or re-ordered. The file digest is published, so the population is checkable.
frame.sample_type: curated convenience sample — the estate's own candidate list, not a probability sample of the axis population
frame.what_this_frame_does_not_license: A rate over a curated convenience sample cannot be read as a population rate. It is a rate over this list, on this date, with this reader.
frame.reader_note: This run's reader is NOT the sha-pinned reader that produced the frame file, so byte digests are not comparable across the two without re-running the frame under the pinned reader.

score_caveat: The headline bar was fixed after today's data was seen. It is a description of this run, not a pre-registered measurement. The class-level census carries no bar and is the primary statistic. A score of exactly 0 or 1 is refused by the estate G2 rule.
limitations: A link-class presence check records observable strings in public bytes at observed_at. Absence on the landed URL is not evidence of absence elsewhere.
This measures disclosure presence, not disclosure quality, truth, or compliance.
A refusal is recorded in its own state and is never converted to a zero.
Not a certification, a rank, or a grade.
